name: suitcase_repaired
note: 3/4 view from slightly above, light from the upper left. idle and turn frames are 136x92; open and close frames are 136x128 (taller, for the lid): same width, and the ground under the case sits on the same row counted from the bottom (32 px up), so anchor every animation bottom-centre. turn is a full 360 degree turn in 32 even steps (drag to rotate). The last frame of close equals the first frame of idle.
